landing.heroSubtitle: Property viewing scheduling for Singapore agents. Simple, clear, one table.
landing.agentHeadline: Manage clients. Schedule viewings. Stay organized.
landing.agentDesc: Manage clients, add properties from Property Guru, schedule viewings in 15-min slots, and share a beautiful schedule with your clients via link.
landing.agent2: One-click add from Property Guru links
landing.clientHeadline: Your schedule. Your properties. In one place.
landing.clientDesc: Add properties you like, track pending viewings, and manage your own viewing schedule. Or use the link from your agent to view a shared schedule.
landing.client1: Add properties and schedule your own viewings
landing.client2: Track pending items and listing agent WhatsApp
landing.client3: View schedule on map with notes
landing.testimonial1: Simple and easy to use. No complicated features. My clients like the clean schedule link.
landing.testimonial2: Replaced my spreadsheet. Now I manage 5 clients without mix-ups.
landing.testimonial3: The map view saves me a lot of driving. Very practical for viewings.
landing.ctaSubtitle: Create a free account and start in seconds. No credit card required.
landing.feature1Desc: Schedule viewings in 15‑min slots. Conflict detection keeps your calendar clear.
landing.feature2Desc: Share view-only or editable links with clients. They see exactly what they need, nothing more.
landing.feature3Desc: See all appointments on a map. Plan routes and save time between viewings.
landing.feature4Desc: Clients, pending items, and appointments—everything in one place.
